card.name: Radiation dose units and 'associated with'
card.fires_on: The Gy part of gray units (mGy, µGy, Gy/GBq) in radiation dosimetry tables, and words inside 'absorbed radiation dose'. Also 'with' after 'associated' in CYP3A contraindication phrases.
